captureScope: Actual public-input screenshot bracket. Both endpoints contain the same fold/current-cell body overlap and a common fresh marked-bite root. Body/silhouette intersection is the renderer helper result; spacing alone is never sufficient. The bite cell and occluded cell need not be identical. Endpoints are not claimed to equal the PNG tick. Pixel readability still needs human inspection; no same-tick cross-browser A/B or universal no-occlusion claim.
projectionScope: Sprite-plane (x=worldX,y=.72*worldY+spriteY) shapes converted with the real sampled camera; these are body bounds and obstacle upper silhouette, excluding beacon cross, labels, marks, hit rings and trails.
